rv.q: An awesome experience for young and old alike.
Barmy Britain is a wonderful way to get children laughing, chanting and clapping along, whilst also learning new things about Britain’s history!
This is educational theatre which entertains while it informs, throwing in just enough gore and giggles to ensure the facts stick.
Overall, an hour of fun and silliness which children will love.
With great audience participation and entertainingly educational fun, Horrible Histories: Barmy Britain is the perfect summer holiday day out.
This is basically a well-made, cleverly structured piece of entertainment, which rattles through UK history with plenty of gore, spade-loads of poo (literally) in panto-esque style.
Fast, funny and wonderfully bonkers, Horrible Histories: Barmy Britain proves that learning has never been so entertaining.

cn.t: Critics find this energetic family show delivers exactly what it promises: 70 minutes of British history packed with poo jokes, catchy songs, and slapstick humor that entertains kids while sneaking in educational value.
